title: Aprite, presto, aprite
subtitle: Susanna and Cherubino: duettino from Le nozze di Figaro, Act 2 (No. 14)
note: Susanna frees Cherubino, who jumps out of the window
about: Score: No. 14, the duettino “Aprite, presto, aprite” (vocal score pages 134-137, 44 bars), from Paul Klengel's piano reduction in the Breitkopf & Härtel vocal score (Edition Breitkopf 1716, about 1900), public domain.
